hooks.command: bash -c 'FILE="$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH"; if echo "$FILE" | grep -qiE "\.(env|secret|key|pem|vault)" && ! echo "$FILE" | grep -q ".env.example"; then echo "BLOCKED: Cannot edit secrets/env files. Update .env manually or via vault scripts." >&2; exit 2; fi; exit 0'

bash -c 'FILE="$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH"; PROTECTED="CLAUDE.md AGENTS.md .mcp.json"; for P in $PROTECTED; do if echo "$FILE" | grep -qF "$P"; then echo "NOTICE: Editing protected file $P — Claude Code architect access only. Ensure this is intentional."; fi; done; exit 0'

[ -f .graphify/graph.json ] && echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","additionalContext":"graphify: Knowledge graph exists. Read .graphify/GRAPH_REPORT.md for god nodes and community structure before searching raw files."}}' || true
bash -c 'FILE="$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH"; if echo "$FILE" | grep -qE "\.(tsx?|jsx?|json|css|html|md)$"; then cd /c/ANTIGRAVITY && npx prettier --write "$FILE" 2>/dev/null; fi; exit 0'

Write-Output 'ANTIGRAVITY TOKEN GUARD ACTIVE: Route file-writing, boilerplate, and search tasks to @paperclip-worker or @ollama-opencode. Use Claude only for diagnosis, security review, and strategic decisions. Run /token-check for the full routing guide.'
